messages.subject: The combination of histogram, facet_wrap and xlim is not working is  not working
parts:
Hi,

For some reason, the following combination of histogram, facet_wrap
and xlim is not working. The other three commented lines work. I'm not
sure where this bug is ('histogram', 'facet_wrap' or 'xlim'). But
could somebody who is familiar with the code fix it. Thank you!

################################
library(ggplot2)

png('main.png')
#qplot(displ,hwy,data=mpg) + facet_wrap( ~ class) + xlim(3,5)
#qplot(displ,geom='histogram',data=mpg) + facet_wrap( ~ class)
qplot(displ,geom='histogram',data=mpg) + facet_wrap( ~ class) + xlim(3,5)
#qplot(displ,geom='histogram',data=mpg) + xlim(3,5)
dev.off()
########################

Error in if (!all(data$ymin == 0)) warning("Stacking not well defined
when ymin != 0", :
missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
Calls: print ... gg_apply -> apply -> FUN -> f -> <Anonymous> -> <Anonymous>
Execution halted


--
Regards,
Peng
